# ── the account's extra Python libraries — ONE PLACE, EVERY SESSION ─────────
# Add a line here and it is installed into the shared environment the next
# time a session starts (or run sync-env.sh by hand to get it right now).
# Already-installed libraries are never touched again: only what you ADD costs
# anything, once, for the whole account, on every testbed.
#
#   networkx
#   torch-geometric==2.5
#
# System (apt) packages cannot be installed this way — list them in
# packages.txt in this folder instead; those are baked by the platform.
